visual_action: The video first shows a static screenshot of a tweet from an account named 'FactPost'. The tweet includes a photo of Donald Trump and another man, likely Nayib Bukele, inside a formal room. The video then cuts to a graphic with a black background. Overlay text reads "Home-grown criminals" with a thinking emoji. Below this is a graphic resembling a news broadcast scoreboard for a court case titled 'PEOPLE OF THE STATE OF NY v DONALD J TRUMP', which lists 34 counts, all marked as 'GUILTY'. The bottom of the graphic summarizes the results as 'GUILTY 34', 'NOT GUILTY 0', and 'NO VERDICT 0'.

intended_effect: To ridicule Donald Trump by using his own (alleged) words against him and highlighting his status as a convicted felon.
